This includes wearing a high-quality mask or respirator, avoiding crowded indoor spaces, and getting tested at least 5 full days after your last exposure. Even if you test negative, continue precautions through day 10.

list.title: Test at Least 5 Days After Exposure:
list.snippet: Get tested for COVID-19 at least five days after your last exposure, even if you don't have symptoms.
